# oblique_user_attribute (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing user attribute by its resource name. Attributes are
# nested under their user — the name has the form
# users/<user>/userattributes/<attribute>.
data "oblique_user_attribute" "janedoe_department" {
  name = "users/janedoe/userattributes/department"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) Create timestamp of the attributes. This is always the same as the parent user.
- `id` (String) The ID is a computed type that always matches 'name'.
- `integration` (String) The integration that manages the attribute.

Format: `integrations/{integration}`
- `key` (String) The key of the attribute, such as "department" or "costCenter".
- `update_time` (String) The last time that attributes were modified.
- `value` (String) The value of the attribute, such as "Engineering" or "12345".
